summary: Iteration 74 — validated Admin PDF Test Dashboard analytics (Mongo logs) + tier=ultra toggle for Thème Natal. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass on public URL — Supabase admin login (admin@plume-astrale.fr) works, all 6 products (astrocartographie, kabbale, karma-destin, numerologie, theme-natal, synastrie) return 200+application/pdf with admin JWT, 401/403 without token, 403 for non-admin (test@plume-astrale.fr), /_logs/recent returns Mongo-inserted logs (logs+stats arrays, no _id leak), tier=ultra flag is persisted in Mongo log entries. Frontend: 5/5 Playwright flows pass — anon→redirect /connexion?redirect=/admin/pdf-test, admin→full dashboard with hero+6 cards+analytics widget (10 rows visible), tier=ultra button shows gold bg rgb(201,162,75) and sends tier=ultra in request URL, non-admin→admin-pdf-test-denied screen with 'Accès réservé aux administrateurs'. FINDING: tier=ultra generates a PDF of ~9.8MB, identical size to tier=flash, because the mocked book_data in _fixture() lacks the internal fields (_em, acte3_chapters, dedication, etc.) that natal_pdf_v2 needs to render the enriched 25+ pages TOC path (gated by `bd = book_data.get('_source') in ('gpt','cache')`). Added '_source':'gpt' to the mock to unlock the gate — but sizes remained identical because other keys (_em with dominant_element/dominant_modality/dominant_element_count, acte3_chapters dict) are still missing → the code likely silently skips those blocks. The toggle END-TO-END wiring (UI→URL→backend receives tier→Mongo log stores tier) works perfectly; only the visual size delta requires a fuller mock.

minor.issue: PDF size identical to tier=flash (~9.86 MB). Mock book_data in routes/pdf_test_admin.py::_fixture is missing `_em` (dict with dominant_element/dominant_modality/dominant_element_count), `acte3_chapters` (dict with 9 keyed entries), `dedication` and other keys expected by natal_pdf_v2. Without them the ultra render silently falls back to the same layout as flash. The review request expects 'notably larger, 25+ pages'.
